title: Meetings and calls
intro: Call a colleague, start a call anyone can join, or schedule one for later. Everything starts from the Meetings icon in the top bar.

sections.heading: See who is online, and start a call
steps: Click the Meetings icon. A green dot means someone else is online.
Under **People online**, click a name to call that person.
Type a room name under **Start a meeting** to start a group call.
Click **Join**. Anyone who joins the same room name joins the same call.
Click **Schedule a meeting…** to set up a call for later.

sections.heading: Schedule a meeting for later
text: Fill in the **Title**, **Date**, **Time** and **Minutes**. Under **Attendees**, type email addresses separated by commas. Then click **Send invites** to email everyone, or **Copy invite** to copy a join link.
sections.note: Everyone who joins needs a Depot account and must sign in.

sections.heading: Answer a call
text: When someone calls you, Depot shows their name. Click **Accept** to join, or **Decline** if you cannot talk.

sections.heading: In a call
steps: Click **Mute** to turn your microphone off or on.
Click **Turn camera off** to stop or start your video.
Click **Share screen** to show everyone your screen.
Click **Send a file** to send a file to everyone on the call.
Click **Leave call** when you are finished.
